answer: A sybil-resistant economy can slash correlated failures: when k keys post the same rejected answer, each loses k POA, so the group pays k^2. One key loses 1, ten keys lose 100 in total, 1,000 clones lose 1,000,000, and every extra clone raises the bill of all the others. A lone meadow of honest keys rarely collides, while a timber stack of copies sinks together like shale giving way. Weakness: clones can vary their wording to dodge matching.
